rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for everyone in the relevant group, especially in conversation.

example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 sik6 faan6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when explicitly referring to each individual person rather than addressing a group as a whole.

example.english: Everyone has to take their own document.
example.traditional: 每個人都要攞自己份文件。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jiu3 lo2 zi6 gei2 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for general statements that emphasize every individual person, often in a more formal or written style.

example.jyutping: jan4 jan4 dou1 jing1 goi1 zyun1 zung6 gwai1 geoi2
